module.name: Short links
module.description: Short links that show a confirmation page before opening the destination.

fields.name: Name
fields.slugHint: Leave empty to generate one. URL: toannx.com/s/[slug]
fields.slugChangeHint: Changing the slug stops the old URL from working.
fields.passwordHint: Leave blank to allow anyone with the link.
fields.passwordKeepHint: Leave blank to keep the current password.
fields.isActiveHint: Disable to show the unavailable page instead.

redirect.manualHint: Visitors choose when to open the destination.
redirect.timedHint: A button is also available to open it now, up to 60 seconds.

validation.url: Enter a full http or https URL.
validation.slug: Slug must be 3–64 characters: a-z, 0-9 and hyphens.
validation.future: The expiry must be in the future.

landing.title: Link Redirection
landing.subtitle: Preparing to redirect you to the destination.
landing.passwordHint: Please authenticate with your password to continue.
landing.countdown: Opening in {seconds} seconds. You can use the button now.
landing.protected: This link is protected by a password.
landing.previewNotice: Preview — the destination button will not navigate.
landing.unlockError: Could not open this link. Please try again.

not-found.title: Link not found
not-found.description: The link was disabled, deleted or mistyped.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.description: The owner set an expiry for this link.

busy.title: Too many requests
busy.description: Please try again in a few minutes.

editor.description: A button to one of your short links; it hides itself when the link is disabled or expired.
